metadata.title: Retro Rock Album Cover with Red Motion Blur

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast band portrait framed by a thick black border, featuring heavy red motion blur and bold italicized sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph of a four-person band is set against a solid black background. The photo is characterized by intense red and orange light streaks and motion blur, creating a chaotic, energetic atmosphere. Bold, italicized sans-serif text in a yellow-to-orange gradient sits at the top and bottom of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic window within a solid black field
Vibrant red motion blur contrasting with dark shadows
Bold italicized text anchoring the top and bottom margins
Warm color gradient in typography mirroring the photo's lighting
coreInvariants: Red-dominant motion blur effect in the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band members are centered in a rectangular window, occupying approximately 60% of the total vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the red jacket acts as the primary focal point within the photo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top header text, down through the red motion blur of the photo, to the bottom title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial solid black negative space surrounds the central image, creating a frame effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red and Orange (motion blur and lighting)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows against a zero-value black background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two different sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides the necessary bold, slanted sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a band in a club setting with heavy red and orange motion blur and light streaks, then mask it into a central rectangle on a solid black canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add all-caps, bold, italicized sans-serif text at the top and bottom using a yellow-to-orange vertical gradient fill.

verificationChecks: Is the text italicized and all-caps?
Is there a thick black border around the image?
Does the central image feature red motion blur?
Is the text color a yellow-orange gradient?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the text gradient
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific band names or logos
Do not include the 'Compact Disc' logo in the corner

mustAchieve: High contrast between black frame and red photo
Sense of movement in the central image

postGenerationChecks: Check for solid black background consistency
Verify the italic angle of the text
Ensure the red blur does not obscure the subjects entirely
Confirm the gradient direction in the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: Central blurred photo + black frame + bold italicized gradient sans-serif text.
